Outbound officers search for a fugitive in Washington State and a Vegas-bound Dutch cook is grilled in secondary at Detroit Metro Airport. (S1, ep 12)

How do engineers build and control high-tech, unmanned aircraft? Plus, the process of removing caffeine from coffee is revealed.
How do Japanese chefs prepare poisonous puffer fish and avoid killing their customers? How do Scots weave over 700 types of tartan for kilts?
End Of An ERA. As a hat factory shuts, Serkan rescues industrial relics. Plus, trawling the wares of a prop supplier, Viki finds paintings by a famous local artist.
History Lessons. Serkan buys ancient fire-safety equipment, while Viki wonders if she's lost the plot when she's tempted by a plywood hobbyhorse with a tale to tell.
Mini Pickup & Honda CRX. The boys buy a rare pickup version of a mini. However, the decision about what to do with the tatty canvas load cover causes some creative differences.

The Gold Gypsies make a discovery that could finally catapult their season. Meanwhile, the Victoria Diggers hit red tape, pushing Neville to the edge.
Risky Business. Pete and Sam start a risky project that could set them up for opal riches. Aaron has to mine his way out of debt after buying his late dad's house.
Broke. The Young Guns spend their savings on a hydraulic digger that causes more problems than it solves. And the Blacklighters are dealt a dose of reality!

Standard 14. Henry and Fuzz head to Bristol to help Russell revive his 1947 Standard 14: a post-war classic with charm, history, and plenty of hidden troubles.
Norman. Henry and Fuzz meet Norman, a lifetime petrolhead. His shed is filled with vintage cars, film props, bikes, and classic Mercedes saloons.

items.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
items.sum: Henry and Simon return to Norfolk to check out a farm full of junk. Henry immediately spots a stationary engine and a Fergie tractor while Simon finds a wheeled table.
Angus explores Boyzone star Shane Lynch's super-cars and a camper-van-turned-mini-bar. Then he checks out presenter Julia Bradbury's Victorian chair.
From Memories To New Beginnings. Brenda asks Angus to find new homes for her jewellery collection. But it's her son's childhood toys that might make big bucks on auction day.
Breaking The Mould. There's breakdowns, brisk weather and a macabre discovery for Mark Hill and Margie Cooper as they travel from Darlington to Barnard Castle.
Wheels Of Fortune. Angus travels to Scotland to meet Norma, a widow struggling to let go of her late husband's much-loved possessions as she prepares to downsize.
Helen Flanagan & Bobby Davro. Actress Helen Flanagan asks Angus to sell some Corrie keepsakes and haute couture, while comedian Bobby Davro brings coins and sporting memorabilia.
Deep in the countryside, expert restorers take in Britain's broken and battered artefacts and bring them back to life while learning the rich history of the objects.
How do they run Ryker's Island, one of the biggest jails in the world? How do they make the famous Royal Mail post box? And how do they turn fruit into jam?
How do they make playing cards that can defeat a cheat? How do they brew a billion bottles of lager a year? And how do they make the world's most luxurious private jets?
Gamer Lauren is looking for her perfect player number two to help her reboot her love life. And Ryan is searching for a silver fox with a dad bod.
Bob Mortimer, Richard Ayoade, Jennifer Saunders, Stephen Graham and Hannah Walters join the Goggleboxers for Survivor, Planet Earth III, Teen First Dates and loads more top TV.
Brand new series - Panel: Ava and Gregory are invited to speak on a panel about public schools, while the other teachers complete CPR training.
Half-Decent Proposal: Marge's incredibly rich high school prom date Artie makes Homer and Marge an indecent proposal they can't afford to turn down.
Flashy Little Flashdancer: Beverly takes up dancing. The kids are not impressed. Adam attempts to act cooler than Emmy's handsome new date.
The Opportunity of a Lifetime: Barry gets the chance to throw the first pitch at a Phillies baseball game. Erica makes an important decision about her future.
Thunk in the Trunk: With Claire's business up and running, Phil's got a new role doing all the housework. But he feels invisible, ignored and under-appreciated...
The Storm: When a huge thunderstorm knocks out the power, the whole family congregate at Jay and Gloria's to use their generator. But Jay wants to go to a Navy reunion.
I Don't Know How She Does It: Claire has turned into super mum, running Jay's business and having time for all the duties at home. The kids are happy, but Phil is frustrated.
Groom Billy shocked everyone with a piggy wedding for bride Steph. Now they look back on their oink-tastic big day. Is Billy still making up for a pig mistake? (Ep4)
Tony snaps at Dee Dee, who continues to act up, and Abigail rushes out of a staff meeting after a worrying call. Elsewhere, a resident refuses to keep more secrets.
Alarm bells ring when Sienna realises that Dee Dee spent the night at Abigail's. Ste arranges to meet Imran. And Jack and Pearl plan their big day.
A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sheep.
In Bournemouth, confident Nikki and Steve deal with some boisterous guests. Experienced hosts Peter and Lyn serve up a surprise. And youngsters Nicki and Emily plan a vegan feast.
Café Hon: The Café Hon restaurant in Baltimore is struggling because its owner has alienated the local community. Can Gordon help?
Chiarella's: Gordon Ramsay visits South Philadelphia, where struggling family-run restaurant Chiarella's is pushing owners Tommy and Dina DeFino's marriage to the brink.
Alfonso Ribeiro hosts as home video clips capture funny, surprising and memorable moments. Nine of the series' funniest video clips compete for a $100,000 prize.
Nice Lady: Will finds himself out of his depth with the teenage daughter of a British lord.
Love at First Fight: When one of Vivian's brightest college students starts dating Will, her grades plummet, threatening her future plans.
She of Little Faith: Richard Gere (guest starring as himself) convinces Lisa to become a Buddhist after Bart and Homer burn the church down with a rocket.
Sweets and Sour Marge: Springfield is declared the fattest town on Earth when Homer's attempt to create the world's biggest human pyramid goes disastrously wrong.
Bottle Episode: Homer must transport a million-dollar bottle of wine to Mr Burns's mansion. And for once, it's not actually him who screws it up.
Jaws Wired Shut: Homer becomes a good listener and a calming influence when his jaw is wired shut after he runs into a statue. But Marge is disturbed by his newfound serenity.
Spaceballs: Adam tries to start a Mel Brooks club after watching the movie Spaceballs. Erica plans to tell Beverly and Pops about a big decision she's made.
Let's Val Kilmer This Car: When Lainey turns down Barry's invitation to take her to the prom, he plans a prank with Principal Ball's car to get out of going.
Express Yourself: Phil has the crazy idea of going on a spontaneous trip to Paris with Claire. And Jay takes over their bathroom renovation.
Man Shouldn't Lie: Claire brings home a stray dog and gets the kids to help her hide it. And Cameron rents out the upstairs apartment to a Christian rock band.
Promposal: With Closet-Con imminent, Claire's on high alert and convinced there's a company mole. Phil goes vigilante when he and Gloria confront Alice for stealing her recipe.
Crazy Train: When Dede gets remarried, Manny convinces the family to take the train to the wedding. And Jay's ecstatic that Dede is moving on for good.
Four Regrettings and a Funeral: Homer, Marge, Mr Burns and Kent Brockman each ponder past regrets after the funeral of a much-loved neighbour.
YOLO: Homer embraces a you-only-live-once lifestyle when his old pen pal Eduardo comes to visit. Lisa initiates a new student honour code.
Labor Pains: When Homer helps deliver a baby in a lift, the mother decides to name the child Homer Jr, and Homer quickly develops a deep emotional bond with his young namesake.
The Kid Is All Right: Lisa befriends studious newcomer Isabel but is distressed when her new buddy runs against her in the campaign for class representative.
Abigail and Sienna's feud deepens and the Hutchinsons are in crisis. Meanwhile, there's a tense showdown between Imran and Ste, and Sienna has a proposition for her overlapping family tree.
Brand new series - Alex: Jacob is shocked to find out that his colleagues aren't invested in his frequent email messages. Gregory turns to Janine for help with a former student.
Granny Gets Busy: Uncle Phil's widowed mother, Hattie, arrives in Bel-Air to spend time with the family, but ends up spending even more time with Ed Downer, the local handyman.
Guess Who's Coming to Marry?: The Banks family are prepared for Aunt Janice's wedding, but completely unprepared to meet her groom.

Jacqui Joseph finds a timber coffee table, vintage sideboard and a pair of throne chairs, ripe for recycling, in Altrincham. S15, Ep10

Alyce, who's 89, is brought to King's after falling near her home. Sean, who's 23, is rushed in after having a seizure that's lasted most of the night.

Geordie mum and daughter Leslie and Emily welcome their rivals to the Park Farm Guest House. But sparks fly over the north/south divide.

Dave the three-legged Labrador needs a new best friend. Is setter-poodle Obi the joy and chaos Mike and Tracey need in their life? And a Westie and a Staffie vie for attention.

items.sum: Chester Zoo's crocodiles need a blood test. But who wants to stick a needle in one of the world's most dangerous reptiles? And a giant rat called George has a bad tummy ache.
Brand new series: On Tory Island and Papa Westray, we meet the residents maintaining their unique culture and customs. And why is Hilbre only accessible for a few hours at a time?
Some patients at King's have obvious symptoms while others initially baffle the medical team. Consultant Graham thinks Icylyn's bloated abdomen could be due to something serious.
Bobby, 48, is brought to King's by his partner after having seizures at home. Ronald, 70, is having problems breathing. Rienelle, who's seven, has fallen and landed on her back.

Best Self: Michael gets into a sticky situation, while Eleanor has an idea that leads Chidi, Tahani, Jason and even Janet to put their feelings on the line.
